Messages.Author: Jon Cooper
Messages.Body:
Greetings

Player A plays a Malkvaian Time Auction on his war ghoul.

The bidding starts.

Scenario A: At what point would it be legal too tap the war ghoul to
destroy a location (and the war ghoul) and what would happen to the bids
placed so far?

Scenario B: A War Ghoul is Spirit marionetted. Can you tap war ghoul to
destroy a location before bleeding?

Thanks
Jon

>Greetings

>
>Scenario A: At what point would it be legal too tap the war ghoul to
>destroy a location (and the war ghoul) and what would happen to the bids

i think you have to resolve the bidding (as part of the reolution of
the malk time auction card) before you can do other effects, such as
tap the war ghoul. once the time auction hits the table and names the
ghoul, it's too late to tap and burn.

>Scenario B: A War Ghoul is Spirit marionetted. Can you tap war ghoul to
>destroy a location before bleeding?

yes.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
robtreasure wrote:
> Does this resolution of bidding apply to Heidleberg useage as well?

This resolution of effects (effects are resolved when played) applies
to everything unless otherwise stated (e.g., actions and strikes do
not resolve when played - they resolve later during their respective
resolution steps).

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <4702...@web2news.com>, robtreasure <robtreasure.news.inval

i...@web2news.net> writes:
>Does this resolution of bidding apply to Heidleberg useage as well?

You can't use a Heidelberg in the middle of Time Auction, no - the
auction is part of the resolution.

More importantly, you can't use it in the middle of Hostile Takeover or
Temptation of Greater Power et al.
